page.title: For Employers — Hire Vietnam Remote Talent
page.description: Hire vetted remote talent in Vietnam — verified listings, salary range required, and results in two weeks or your money back.

hero.desc: 500+ qualified VN/SEA professionals. Verified employers only. Salary range required. The signal-to-noise ratio of LinkedIn at a fraction of the cost.
hero.guarantee: 30-day money-back guarantee · No card on file required

why.title: Smaller pool.
why.desc: We're not trying to be the biggest. We're trying to be the place where the right VN candidates actually apply — and you get to interview five people, not five hundred.

1.title: Better response rate
1.desc: VN talent we surveyed report applying to 3.5× more relevant roles here than on LinkedIn. The 'remote-from-VN-friendly' signal saves them hours of guesswork.

2.title: Median time to hire
2.desc: From listing live to signed offer, our median is 14 days. Because the applicants self-select — verified employer, salary stated, timezone clear.

3.title: Listings filled
3.desc: Of all jobs posted in 2025, 87% were filled within the 30-day window. The 13% that weren't either paused or relisted with adjusted comp.

1.title: Submit your role
1.desc: A 15-minute form: role, level, salary range, timezone needs, must-haves. You can paste from an existing JD; we'll structure it.

2.title: We review & verify
2.desc: Within 4–8 working hours, a real person at RemoteSEA checks the company, validates the comp range against our data, and flags issues.

3.title: Receive matched candidates
3.desc: Listing goes live, alerts go out to subscribers in your category, and applications flow into a single dashboard. Median to first hire: 14 days.

case.desc: Finch Labs (SG) needed a full-stack engineer for cross-border payments rails — Series A, 22 people, looking for someone with Postgres scars.
case.quote: "LinkedIn was sending us 200 applies, mostly noise. RemoteSEA sent 42 — and 12 of those were genuinely strong. We hired #4."
case.author: Co-founder & CTO · Finch Labs

pricing.title: One-time, not

pricing.guarantee: 30-day money-back guarantee. Qualified applications or full refund.

STANDARD.name: Standard
STANDARD.desc: A clean 30-day listing on the board.

FEATURED.name: Featured
FEATURED.desc: Front of the queue, amber highlight, alerts to subscribers.

HANDS_ON.name: Hands-on
HANDS_ON.desc: We screen the applicants. You see the top 5.

1.a: A real human at RemoteSEA (currently: the founder) checks your company website, LinkedIn, hiring page, and at least one team member. We confirm the role is open, the team exists, and the comp range is honest. Takes 4–8 working hours.

2.q: Why do you require a salary range?
2.a: Because hiding the range wastes everyone's time. Candidates who would never accept your max apply anyway; candidates who'd love your role skip you because they assumed the worst. We've published 200+ jobs with ranges — the data shows applications go up, not down.

3.q: Can I post a role that pays in VND?
3.a: Yes, but the listing must convert to USD/month for comparison (we'll help). VN talent comparing your role against SG roles needs a like-for-like number. We do this automatically.

4.q: What if I want to hire as a contractor, not FTE?
4.a: Totally fine. ~30% of our roles are contract. We don't take a cut of payments or require you to use a specific EOR — you handle that side. Wise, Deel, and direct wire are all common.

5.a: No. Free for talent. Forever. Revenue comes from employer postings only.

6.q: What if my listing doesn't work out?
6.a: 30-day money-back guarantee. If you don't receive a single qualified application (we'll judge fairly — qualified means meets your stated must-haves), you get a full refund. No questions.

final.desc: Fifteen minutes to list. Eight hours to publish. Two weeks to hire.
